title: cmd_peer_blacklist: always returns 'blacklisted' even if peer_id does not exist
description: cli/peers.rs cmd_peer_blacklist(): UPDATE peers SET blacklisted_until=? WHERE peer_id=? — if no row matches, rows_affected()=0 and the result is still discarded. The function returns format\!("Peer '{peer_id}' blacklisted until...") unconditionally. Operator runs 'transit peer-blacklist nonexistent-peer' and sees success, but the peer is not in the table so nothing was blacklisted. Should check rows_affected and return an appropriate 'peer not found' message.
